[vc_row css=”.vc_custom_1560786853911{margin-bottom: -50px !important;}”][vc_column][vc_row_inner equal_height=”yes”][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417813494{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

Web Development

B2 Provides Web and Mobile Application (for iOS and Android) development service . Our dedicated CMS team build content mandated websites that match your business needs. An impressive online presence is a necessity for any business.

 

Details
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417805392{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

Graphic Design

B2 Provides Graphic Designing for small and large companies.
Details
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417810424{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

Video & Photography

B2 Provides Video & Photography. Be it location-specific shoots, product and service photography.
Details
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417825192{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

Branding & Rebranding

Your brand is more than just a logo; it’s the story, personality, and promise you share with your audience. At Binary Bridge Technology Services, we specialize in creating and transforming brands that leave a lasting impact. Whether you’re starting from scratch or looking to refresh your existing brand, we’re here to guide you every step of the way.
Details
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417820595{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

Digital Marketing

B2 bring forth an entourage of Digital Marketing Services, which includes, online marketing, search engine optimization, pay per click, social media optimization, consulting, email marketing and more. We help your business reach its true potential in the form of lead generation, enhanced ROI and a capacity to explore a more customer-oriented approach.
Details
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417829847{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

Social Wifi

Social Wifi is a revolutionary way to turn your wifi into a powerful data collection marketing tool.
Track your busiest times.
Tailor your events on the language.
Different ages, different needs.
Details
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height=”yes”][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417813494{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

Network Solutions

B2 offers unbeatable IT, Network & Security solutions across the nationwide, delivering flexible, fast and efficient systems suited to your business. Being partner with major vendors providing IT Network Solutions and having certified team B2 can help your business to function under secure and reliable IT infrastructure.
Details
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417805392{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

IT Outsourcing

B2  IT outsourcing services allow business executives to retain control over IT strategies while benefiting from reduced operating costs and risks without compromising service delivery to end users and their clients. With B2 managed service model, we assume responsibility for operations delivery, drawing on IT governance best practices.
Details
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417810424{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

Cloud Computing Services

B2 have the right infrastructure and knowledge to help you transition to the cloud — the private, public, or hybrid cloud environment that’s best suited for your business needs and goals. B2 maintains the highest level of certification for architecting, migrating, and deploying SaaS,  PaaS,  IaaS  and  STaaS  applications to move your business to the cloud.
Details
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][vc_row_inner equal_height=”yes”][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417813494{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

ADHICS Medical Inspection & Consultancy

Healthcare organizations face strict regulations to ensure the safety, security, and quality of patient care. At Binary Bridge Technology Services, we specialize in ADHICS (Abu Dhabi Health Information and Cyber Security Standard) medical inspection and consultancy, providing expert guidance to help you achieve and maintain compliance with these critical standards.
Details
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″ css=”.vc_custom_1560417805392{padding-bottom: 50px !important;}”]

Healthcare and Medical Centre Software Services

In the fast-evolving world of healthcare, efficient and reliable software solutions are critical for delivering exceptional patient care. At Binary Bridge Technology Services, we provide cutting-edge software services tailored to the unique needs of healthcare facilities and medical centres, streamlining operations and enhancing the quality of care.
Details
[/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][/vc_row]
